config.cameraculling.title: Camera Culling Configuration
config.cameraculling.category.general.to: Core culling engine settings and live diagnostics.
config.cameraculling.enabled.desc: Master toggle to enable or disable all frustum and occlusion culling.
config.cameraculling.level.desc: Controls sampling density, proximity safety bubble, and bounding box padding.
config.cameraculling.debugMode.desc: Logs live culling state transitions and sightline reasons directly to chat and latest.log.
config.cameraculling.category.entities.t: Settings for entity-behind-entity crowd overdraw culling and boss immunities.
config.cameraculling.cullEntitiesBehindE: Hides entities completely occluded by other mobs in dense clusters (e.g. crowded mob pens).
config.cameraculling.maxEntitiesPerClust: Maximum number of visible entities in a dense 1.5-block cluster before rear entities are culled.
config.cameraculling.bossImmunity.desc: Always renders bosses (Ender Dragon, Wither, Warden, modded elites) through walls.
config.cameraculling.bossHealthThreshold: Entities with max health above this value are automatically treated as bosses.
config.cameraculling.miniBossHealthThres: Entities with max health above this value are treated as mini-bosses.
Fine-grained controls for particles, tile entities, and texture animations.
config.cameraculling.cullParticles.desc: Culls particles located behind solid blocks and outside the camera view frustum.
config.cameraculling.cullAnimations.desc: Freezes 3D block animations and skips off-screen texture atlas animation uploads.
Optional mipmap texture bias reduction for very far distant entities.
config.cameraculling.distanceTextureLodS: Distance in blocks where texture LOD transitions begin.
config.cameraculling.distanceTextureLodF: Distance in blocks where full texture LOD is reached.
